prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.autoHint: Auto follows the sun where you are: dawn, day, dusk and night.
prefs.voiceHint: Reads the result aloud when a check finishes. Tap the speaker to stop.
prefs.reduceMotionHint: Switches off the big animations: the water rising over the map, the core lifting out of the pin and numbers counting up. Turn it on if motion bothers you or the phone feels slow.
prefs.clearAsk: Delete every place on this phone?
prefs.clearBody: Recent and saved places and their readings leave this phone. Anything backed up to your account stays there.
